title: USF-171 Static Analysis Quality-Gate Disposition Matrix

humanDecision.summary: SonarQube/static-analysis decision is not completion evidence. USF-171 records a bounded disposition gate: local deterministic repository verification is mandatory but not SonarQube service equivalence. USF-195 records the explicit service-proof boundary lineage. USF-204 records a bounded local Compose SonarQube scanner and quality-gate proof. USF-233 records the zero-open-issue gate for the supported local synthetic scan scope only, while operator UI clickthrough, quality-gate policy administration, hotspot human review, OIDC plugin depth, and environment promotion remain explicitly deferred.

sonarqubeDisposition.riskStatement: SonarQube service semantics, unresolved issue handling, security hotspot treatment, and quality-gate exception workflow could be overclaimed from local repository verification output.
sonarqubeDisposition.treatment: USF-204 proves bounded local Compose scanner submission and quality-gate readback. USF-233 enforces quality-gate OK, zero unresolved issues, and zero security hotspots for the supported local synthetic scan scope. UI clickthrough, policy administration, hotspot human review, OIDC plugin depth, live-provider operation, repository-wide SonarQube readiness, and environment promotion remain deferred or prohibited.
deferredEvidence: security hotspot human review workflow evidence
sonar-oidc-plugin bootstrap and identity integration evidence

localVerificationGate.substitutionNonEquivalenceBoundary: Repository validation commands are mandatory local deterministic verification evidence, but they are not equivalent to SonarQube service history, dashboards, issue lifecycle, security hotspot workflow, or quality-gate operations.
limits: no repository-wide or live-provider zero-issue quality gate beyond the USF-233 supported local synthetic scan scope

operatorAccessAuditRetentionSupplierBoun.operatorAccessBoundary: USF-204 validates authenticated local API access for the proof credential; SonarQube browser UI clickthrough and public exposure remain deferred to USF-169 or later operator/gateway work.
operatorAccessAuditRetentionSupplierBoun.retentionBoundary: USF-204 deletes the temporary synthetic project and revokes the temporary proof credential; no scanner findings or source-analysis payloads are retained as readiness evidence.
operatorAccessAuditRetentionSupplierBoun.secretBoundary: No SonarQube credential, token value, raw endpoint, provider payload, scanner log, or connection string is emitted by USF-204 evidence.
operatorAccessAuditRetentionSupplierBoun.supplierBoundary: Local generated Compose service is not supplier/live-provider evidence; supplier posture is required before live-provider or production claims.
operatorAccessAuditRetentionSupplierBoun.incidentBoundary: No production incident or vulnerability-response workflow is proven by USF-171 or USF-195.
